'''Scott Malnar''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 2nd at [[May 2001 Ottawa tournament]] on 27 May 2001, according to Thomas Dowling's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2380">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-27-ottawa-canada-27-5-01d2380/ ottawa-canada-27-5-01], DeckTech (Thomas "COTEB" Dowling, 27 May 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-27-ottawa-canada-27-5-01d2380/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
